corrections: scripts/phase33_selection.py:8-10 and scripts/mi6_test_read.py:1-16 both assert 'the frozen test is read exactly once'. This is true of each script's OWN guard file, not of the project.
reports/mi_status.md:221-222 ('the test is read exactly once, in MI-6') is contradicted by the Phase-33 read log and by this ledger.

final workflow.md D15 (line 87) states the model is 'frozen at Phase 33 ... must not re-select'; MI-5 re-selected and MI-6 re-read the test for D16. This is disclosed (D16 supersedes), but the original 'no re-selection' rule was not honoured as written.

There is no project-level read guard. Each guard counts only its own file and counts scored rows (1,198,056), not window opens. New scripts (e.g. MI-7) must consult THIS ledger and add an entry rather than print 'read exactly once'.
operating_rule_going_forward: MI-7 and later phases keep the frozen test SEALED (test_rows_read = 0). Any future test read must be pre-registered, added to this ledger, and reported as an additional read - the 'exactly once' framing must not be reused.
